name: Towser
description: A veteran wizard who hires Gull, plans to kill Greensleeves for her power, and is revealed to have killed Gull's family.

description_citations.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser and Karli lead a surprise attack on her camp; Haakon fireballs Gull.
timeline.quote: Haakon unleashed a fireball at Gull, seemingly killing him

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser and Karli summon nine defeated wizards to the tropical island; Towser has stolen and copied the Nova Pentacle and reveals his Keldon warlord.
timeline.quote: Towser reveals that he has stolen Greensleeves' Nova Pentacle and copied it.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser and the wizards attack the army; the army retreats into the tunnel where Gull has a prophetic dream and realizes the warlord's identity.
timeline.quote: he doesn't see Sparrow Hawk , his long-lost brother, and has a revelation about the warlord's identity.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull reveals to the warlord that he is Sparrow Hawk, kidnapped and enchanted by Towser, and the brothers reconcile; Haakon engulfs them in a fireball.
timeline.quote: the two brothers reconcile. However, Haakon unleashes a fireball against the two, which are engulfed in flames.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic with the Stone Brain; Gull lets other wizards keep magic only to do good; the wizards pledge obedience and she is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
timeline.quote: who is declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: White Ridge is destroyed during a wizards' duel, killing Greensleeves' parents and two of her siblings.
timeline.quote: many of the villagers were killed, including Greensleeves' parents and two of her siblings

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Dim-witted". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser hires Gull as freightmaster and Gull brings Greensleeves along.
timeline.quote: Gull, confused by the mind magic of Towser and with nowhere else to go, accepted his offer and brought Greensleeves along.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Dim-witted". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser reveals his plan to kill Greensleeves and store her power in the mana vault; a fight starts and Towser teleports Gull and friends to an island.
timeline.quote: the wizard revealed his intention to kill Greensleeves and store her power in the mana vault

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Wizard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lily summons Gull back; Kem changes sides and Greensleeves, revealed as a wizard, summons the creatures of the woods against Towser's minions.
timeline.quote: Kem changed sides and came to her rescue

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Wizard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves uses an earthquake and a tsunami to defeat Towser, who escapes by flying; Gull's group survives and they vow to form an army against evil wizards.
timeline.quote: They vowed to form an army to fight Towser and all other evil wizards who saw people as mindless pawns.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Wizard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ten wizards led by Towser and Karli, with Ur-Drago and a Keldon warlord, attack the army from three directions; Greensleeves banishes Ur-Drago, losing Petalia to the Abyss.
timeline.quote: Petalia , captain of her bodyguard, was lost in the Abyss when the druid banished Ur-Drago.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser and the other wizards attack; Gull's prophetic dream reveals the Keldon warlord is his brother.
timeline.quote: this made him realize what the warlord's identity was

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull reveals to the warlord that he is Sparrow Hawk, and the brothers reconcile.
timeline.quote: the two brothers reconciled

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic with the Stone Brain; the other wizards keep theirs to do good and pledge obedience, and she is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
timeline.quote: who was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "High Wizard of the Domains". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: White Ridge is destroyed in a wizards' duel, killing Gull's parents and two siblings.
timeline.quote: many of the villagers were killed, including Gull's parents and two of his siblings

citation.text: "Gull", section "Whispering Woods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser asks Gull to become his freightmaster and Gull, confused by mind magic, accepts and brings Greensleeves.
timeline.quote: Gull, confused by the mind magic of Towser and with nowhere else to go, accepted his offer

citation.text: "Gull", section "Whispering Woods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser reveals he will kill Greensleeves to store her power in the mana vault and teleports Gull, Morven and Stiggur to an island.
timeline.quote: Towser was forced to teleport Gull away

citation.text: "Gull", section "The island". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Summoned back by Lily, Gull fights Towser; Kem changes sides and Greensleeves casts an earthquake and tsunami, sweeping away Morven, Kem and most of Towser's entourage.
timeline.quote: Gull and his friends vowed to form an army to fight Towser

citation.text: "Gull", section "Fighting Towser". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves teleports the survivors to safety as Towser's wizards and a Keldon warlord attack from three directions.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves teleported herself, Gull, and the survivors of their army to their headquarters

citation.text: "Gull", section "General". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Lat-Nam Gull realizes the warlord is his lost brother Sparrow Hawk and the brothers reconcile.
timeline.quote: the two brothers reconciled

citation.text: "Gull", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dacian and Towser duel and destroy White Ridge; Gull pledges to kill any wizard he meets.
timeline.quote: Gull the Woodcutter, one of the survivors, pledged an oath to kill any wizard he met.

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser reveals himself as the cause of the destruction, sends Gull to an island and kidnaps Greensleeves.
timeline.quote: transporting Gull away to a tropical island and kidnapping Greensleeves

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull is summoned back; Kem changes sides and Greensleeves, revealed as a wizard, summons her allies and uses an earthquake and tsunami against Towser.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves put her hand in the sea and cast another spell - a tsunami .

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic, the other wizards are allowed to keep theirs for good, and she is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves, who was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers.

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves kills Haakon after he hits her brother, traps the wizards and absorbs a Force of Nature, nearly losing herself until Kwam restores her sanity.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves, in a fit of grief and rage, killed Haakon

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "Battle of Lat-Nam". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dacian fights Towser in the destruction of White Ridge, then is pursued and subdued by the Stone Brain.
timeline.quote: After fleeing White Ridge , she was pursued by Gull and Greensleeves and was subdued by the Stone Brain .

citation.text: "Mina", section "Dacian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ludoc abandons Towser, is drained by Greensleeves and swears loyalty to her.
timeline.quote: He submitted to Greensleeves and swore loyalty and allegiance to save his magic from being drained completely.

citation.text: "Mina", section "Ludoc". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves frees Dacian and Haakon, who form a truce and seek Karli to stop the crusade.
timeline.quote: Dacian and Haakon form a truce and seek out Karli

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull and Greensleeves see the Brain fall as a star; Towser retrieves it, thinking it a mana vault.
timeline.quote: the wizard Towser retrieved it with their help, believing it to be a mana vault

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The army captures Dacian and puts the helmet on him; Dacian and Haakon form a truce and seek Karli and Towser.
timeline.quote: Dacian and Haakon formed a truce

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic; Gull lets the others keep magic only for good; Greensleeves keeps the last secret to herself.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves used the Stone Brain to strip Towser of his magic

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull finds stranded centaurs and a giant; Towser asks Gull to be his freight master and Gull accepts, confused by Towser's mind magic.
timeline.quote: Gull, confused by the mind magic of Towser and with nowhere else to go, accepts his offer.

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The convoy reaches the fallen star, a Mana Vault; another wizard attacks, trying to kidnap Lily and Greensleeves, and is defeated by a Fungusaur.
timeline.quote: The star is revealed by Towser to be a Mana Vault

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull discovers Greensleeves can now talk; Towser reveals he intends to kill her and store her power in the Mana Vault and teleports Gull, Morven and Stiggur away amid a riot.
timeline.quote: the wizard reveals his intention to kill Greensleeves and store her power in the Mana Vault.

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lily, secretly a wizard, summons Gull; Kem changes sides, and Greensleeves, revealed as a wizard, summons allies and then an earthquake that plunges them into the sea.
timeline.quote: She resolves to use an earthquake , which destroys the cliff they are on and plunges them into the sea.

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser escapes a tsunami by flight; Morven and Kem are swept away; Gull realizes Towser killed his family and vows to form an army against evil wizards.
timeline.quote: Gull and his friends vow to form an army to fight Towser

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
